name: migration_flow
definition: People or households moving from one place or population system to another
notes: Use only where movement is measured or defensibly inferred.

name: trade_flow
definition: Goods or services moving from one entity or place to another
notes: Preserve commodity/service type and measurement basis in domain data.

name: information_flow
definition: Information or attention moving between entities or places
notes: Do not equate attention with influence or physical presence.

name: cultural_influence
definition: Documented or hypothesised influence of one cultural form or system on another

name: cultural_derivation
definition: A cultural variant materially derived from another variant
notes: Use with cultural variant provenance and transformation evidence.

name: dependency
definition: One entity materially depends on another for a specified function or resource
notes: Record the dependency basis and alternatives where known.

name: competition
definition: Entities compete for a specified resource market audience or capacity
notes: Direction may be asymmetric even where competition is reciprocal.

name: collaboration
definition: Entities cooperate toward a shared activity or output
notes: Represent directed roles separately where evidence requires it.

name: infrastructure_connection
definition: Infrastructure directly connects two places or systems
notes: Direction may represent flow capacity rather than ownership.

name: institutional_link
definition: Formal or informal institutional relationship between entities
notes: Do not assume legal form from a generic institutional link.

name: beneficiary_flow
definition: A service or intervention provides a direct or indirect benefit to an entity or population
notes: Use with intervention and beneficiary layers.

name: event_disruption
definition: An event interrupts or materially changes an existing relationship
notes: Prefer relationship_events when the event linkage is explicit.

name: supply_chain
definition: An entity supplies an input to another entity
notes: Preserve material/service identity and stage in domain data.

name: return_flow
definition: A flow returns from a destination to an origin or prior node
notes: Useful for cultural feedback and reciprocal material/economic flows.
